name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Government-backed pension scheme for workers in the unorganised sector, providing a guaranteed monthly pension after the age of 60.
benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000 after age 60

conditions.label: Must be at least 18 years old
Must be at most 40 years old
Must have a savings bank account
Must not be an income tax payer
